name: Drift recovery claims (Insurance Fund refunds, DFX)
what: After the April 2026 Drift exploit, Insurance Fund stakers get their USDC, SOL and other staked tokens back and affected traders get DFX (one per $1 lost); unclaimed refunds are clawed back on 2027-07-01, unclaimed DFX is burned on 2028-01-01
how_to_check: holdings.perps_sol (in scan.sol) reads the dfx.drift.trade eligibility of the wallet; claim on https://dfx.drift.trade/

name: Midnight NIGHT redemption
what: NIGHT tokens from the Midnight Glacier Drop / Scavenger Mine that were allocated but not redeemed
how_to_check: Cardano, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and other holders at the snapshot: check the Midnight redemption portal

name: Stargate v1 pools close
what: Stargate v1 liquidity (S*USDC, S*ETH and other v1 LP tokens, plus v1 farms) stops working when LayerZero retires the v1 relayer
how_to_check: any Stargate position in rewards.zerion (types=deposit,staked) or a v1 LP token in holdings

name: MKR to SKY upgrade penalty grows
what: MKR upgrades to SKY at 1:24,000 minus a penalty that started at 1% on 2025-09-22 and rises 1 point every 3 months (about 5% in Oct 2026)
how_to_check: any MKR balance

name: Polygon zkEVM exit claims
what: Balances left on Polygon zkEVM when its sequencer stopped (2026-07-03) are claimable on Ethereum from an exit snapshot
how_to_check: connect the wallet on the claims page (EOA balances only; DeFi positions and multisigs are not covered)

name: Gravity Alpha (L2) shuts down
what: Assets left on Gravity Alpha Mainnet (chain 1625) stop being transferable; G staking on Galxe closes the same day
how_to_check: native G balance on chain 1625 (rpc.gravity.xyz); bridge G, DAI, WBTC with the Gravity bridge (Fast Withdraw skips the 7 day wait), USDC/USDT/ETH with Stargate

name: MATIC to POL migration
what: MATIC on Ethereum can still be migrated 1:1 to POL (no deadline announced, no penalty)
how_to_check: any MATIC balance on Ethereum

name: LayerZero ends support for low-activity chains
what: LayerZero retires DVN, Executor and Stargate support for Gravity, Camp, Lisk, GOAT, and Metis on 2026-10-30
how_to_check: Stargate and bridge assets on these chains: bridge or redeem assets before 2026-10-30

name: Balancer pool wind-down proposal
what: Proposal to make Balancer pools withdraw-only on 2026-10-30 and pause v3 Vault on 2026-11-30; exit liquidity early
how_to_check: rewards.balancer (in scan.evm) lists the wallet's BPT on every Balancer chain, in the wallet or staked in a gauge or Aura, valued at the underlying (v1 pools too, no deadline)

name: KNCL to KNC migration
what: Old Kyber Network Crystal (KNCL) tokens upgrade 1:1 to new KNC via KNC.mintWithOldKnc
how_to_check: any KNCL balance on Ethereum

name: RPL v1 to RPL migration
what: Old Rocket Pool v1 tokens can be swapped 1:1 for new RPL via RocketTokenRPL.swapTokens
how_to_check: any RPL v1 balance on Ethereum

name: RNDR to RENDER upgrade
what: Old RNDR (ERC-20 on Ethereum) upgrades 1:1 to RENDER, the Render Network token on Solana, through the Render upgrade portal (the RNDR is burned); no deadline announced
how_to_check: any RNDR balance on Ethereum (0x6De037ef9aD2725EB40118Bb1702EBb27e4Aeb24); connect the Ethereum wallet and a Solana wallet on the portal

name: RNDR to RENDER upgrade (Polygon)
what: RNDR on Polygon upgrades 1:1 to RENDER on Solana through the Polygon upgrade portal, all at once (one upgrade per wallet); no deadline announced
how_to_check: any RNDR balance on Polygon (0x61299774020dA444Af134c82fa83E3810b309991)

name: STG to ZRO conversion closes
what: STG converts to ZRO at 1 STG = 0.08634 ZRO on the Stargate site until 2026-12-15; LayerZero stops supporting conversions after that. The whole balance converts at once, on Ethereum (redemption swapper 0x921949cc006A563D76Abd111a3e4c2ACe2C4273f)
how_to_check: any STG balance on Ethereum

name: STG to ZRO conversion closes (Arbitrum)
what: STG converts to ZRO at 1 STG = 0.08634 ZRO until 2026-12-15, on Ethereum only: STG on Arbitrum is bridged to Ethereum first (the Stargate site prompts it), then the whole balance converts
how_to_check: any STG balance on Arbitrum
